lines.en: label rindorm30:
I knock on the door and press my ear against it, waiting to see if Rin and Futaba are in.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，把耳朵贴在门上，等着看 Rin 和 Futaba 在不在。

lines.en: Rin mentioned recently that the two of them would be hanging out and chatting sometime soon, so I’m wondering if that’s what’s going on tonight.
lines.zh: Rin 最近提过，她们两个不久之后要聚在一起聊聊天，所以我在想今晚是不是就是那个时候。

lines.en: : Who is it?
lines.zh: : 谁啊？

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. It’s me. Can I come in?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。是我。能进来吗？

lines.en: : Sensei? One second. Rin just needs to-
lines.zh: : Sensei？等一下。Rin 只是需要——

lines.en: : I’m fine. He can come in.
lines.zh: : 我没事。他可以进来。

lines.en: : Wait...really? Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 等等……真的？你确定吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。我不介意。

lines.en: : That’s...Uhh, well...Okay.
lines.zh: : 那……呃，好吧……好吧。

lines.en: : The door’s open, Sensei. You can come in.
lines.zh: : 门开着呢，Sensei。你可以进来了。

lines.en: scene black
I pull the door open and make my way into the room.
lines.zh: 我拉开门，走进房间。

lines.en: The distorted sounds of some angsty garage band leak through the speakers of Rin’s laptop and make their way to the opposite side of the room, where the two of them are laying.
lines.zh: 某个烦躁的车库乐队走调的声音从 Rin 的笔记本扬声器里漏出来，飘到房间另一头——她们两个正躺在那儿。

lines.en: I gently bring myself to my knees and crouch down beside them.
lines.zh: 我轻轻跪下来，蹲在她们旁边。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba1
: Hey, man. Welcome to the bedroom.
lines.zh: : 嘿，老兄。欢迎来到卧室。

lines.en: : As you can see, I am not wearing pants. Please ignore this fact.
lines.zh: : 如你所见，我没穿裤子。请无视这个事实。

lines.en: : I will do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽力。

lines.en: : That’s...why I was hesitant to let you in.
lines.zh: : 那就是……我刚才犹豫要不要让你进来的原因。

lines.en: : I knew you two had gotten close, but I didn’t realize it was “No pants” close...
lines.zh: : 我知道你们两个变得亲近了，但没想到已经到了「不穿裤子」的亲近程度……

lines.en: : It’s whatever. I’m lacking the willpower to reject anything right now.
lines.zh: : 无所谓啦。我现在连拒绝任何事的意志力都没有。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba2
: Please don’t say things that will make me worry about you even more.
lines.zh: : 别再说让我更担心你的话了。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba3
: Heheh~ Sorry...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~抱歉……

lines.en: : So...any new developments in Rin Rokuhara’s eternal struggle against heartbreak?
lines.zh: : 那么……Rin Rokuhara 与心碎的永恒抗争中，有什么新进展吗？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba4
: Just getting right to the point, huh?
lines.zh: : 这就直奔主题了啊？

lines.en: : There...is one thing that happened. Though, Rin seems to be taking it a lot worse than I think she should.
lines.zh: : 确实……发生了一件事。不过，Rin 的反应在我看来比她该有的要严重得多。

lines.en: : Well what hap-
lines.zh: : 发生什么——

lines.en: : She texted me.
lines.zh: : 她给我发短信了。

lines.en: : Who? Chika?
lines.zh: : 谁？Chika？

lines.en: : Of course, Chika.
lines.zh: : 当然是 Chika。

lines.en: : Well, isn’t that a good thing?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那不是好事吗？

lines.en: : That’s what I was saying. Rin won’t even reply to her.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么说的。可 Rin 连回都不回她。

lines.en: : I’m too embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 我太丢人了。

lines.en: : Besides, she said the three words no one ever wants to hear.
lines.zh: : 而且，她说了那三个没人想听到的字。

lines.en: : ...I love you?
lines.zh: : ……我爱你？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba5
: I fucking wish.
lines.zh: : 我做梦都希望是。

lines.en: : All she said was “Can we talk?”
lines.zh: : 她只说了「我们能聊聊吗」。

lines.en: : Like, what am I supposed to say to that?
lines.zh: : 就，这让我怎么回啊？

lines.en: : {i}Hey, remember when I confessed my feelings to you and then promptly ran away? Sorry about that. Wanna be friends again?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿，还记得我跟你表白完就立刻跑掉了吗？那事抱歉啦。还想再做回朋友吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene rinfutaba6
: I fucked up. I did everything wrong.
lines.zh: : 我搞砸了。每一步都做错了。

lines.en: : That’s not true.
lines.zh: : 不是那样。

lines.en: : You were finally able to say how you’ve felt about her since middle[school] or whenever it was.
lines.zh: : 你终于说出了从初中[school]起、或者不管从什么时候起你对她的感觉。

lines.en: : That’s not something you should just dismiss. It’s a big step.
lines.zh: : 那不是你该一笔带过的事。那是很大的一步。

lines.en: : A step backwards, yeah. Two steps, even.
lines.zh: : 是倒退的一步，没错。甚至是两步。

lines.en: : What’s the point of getting something off of your chest if you’re just going to lose something else in the process?
lines.zh: : 如果到头来要以失去另一样东西为代价，那把心里话说出来又有什么意义？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba7
: But...maybe you didn’t lose anything? That’s probably what Chika wants to talk about.
lines.zh: : 不过……也许你什么都没失去呢？那大概就是 Chika 想聊的事。

lines.en: : I’m with Futaba on this. Chika isn’t the type to just cast you aside because you have feelings for her.
lines.zh: : 这一点我站 Futaba。Chika 不是那种会因为你喜欢她就把你一脚踢开的人。

lines.en: : Agreed. For example, what would you do if you found out I’ve always had feelings for you, Rin?
lines.zh: : 同意。打个比方，如果你发现我一直都喜欢你，你会怎么做，Rin？

lines.en: : Probably make out with you. You’re hot.
lines.zh: : 大概会跟你接吻吧。你很帅啊。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba8
: That’s not...the answer I was looking for.
lines.zh: : 那不是……我想听到的答案。

lines.en: : I know. You don’t like girls.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你不喜欢女生。

lines.en: : What...I’m trying to get at is that you wouldn’t just leave me behind if you didn’t feel the same way.
lines.zh: : 我……想说的是，就算你对我没有同样的感觉，你也不会就这么把我丢下。

lines.en: : That’s not the type of person you are.
lines.zh: : 你不是那种人。

lines.en: : And I don’t know Chika as well as you do, but I’m pretty sure she isn’t like that either.
lines.zh: : 而我认识 Chika 没有你那么深，但我敢肯定她也不是那种人。

lines.en: : That doesn’t make it hurt any less, though.
lines.zh: : 可那也不会让它少疼一点啊。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba9
: Is it...silly to say that it feels like I’m missing a part of myself now?
lines.zh: : 说……我现在觉得自己缺了一块，是不是很傻？

lines.en: : Actually, don’t answer that. I know it’s silly.
lines.zh: : 算了，别回答了。我知道这很傻。

lines.en: : But it’s like...you spend so long wishing you were with someone and thinking up how things would be if you were together that...
lines.zh: : 只是……你花了那么久盼着能和某个人在一起，想象着在一起之后会是什么样，然后……

lines.en: : Well, hearing that it won’t ever happen is kind of like taking all of those delusions and shoving them into a blender.
lines.zh: : 嗯，听到那件事永远不会发生，就好像把那些幻想全塞进搅拌机里。

lines.en: : And all you can do is watch them be shredded to bits in front of you.
lines.zh: : 而你只能眼睁睁看着它们在你面前被绞成碎片。

lines.en: : Well, what if...whatever comes {i}out{/i} of the blender is even better?
lines.zh: : 嗯，可万一……从搅拌机里{i}出来{/i}的东西反而更好呢？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba10
: I sure hope you have a good explanation for whatever the Hell you meant by that...
lines.zh: : 你最好能给我好好解释一下你他妈那句话到底什么意思……

lines.en: : Me too. That was pretty bad.
lines.zh: : 我也希望我能。那说得挺烂的。

lines.en: : I’m not good at cheering people up. I’ve said this before.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长安慰人。这点我说过了。

lines.en: : But what I mean is, maybe this will open some sort of door for you?
lines.zh: : 但我的意思是，也许这会为你打开某扇门？

lines.en: : Didn’t you tell me on the beach that being rejected might be what you need to move on?
lines.zh: : 你不是在海滩上跟我说过，被拒绝说不定正是你往前走所需要的吗？

lines.en: : I don’t remember anything about the beach. I’ve wiped it all from my memory already.
lines.zh: : 海滩的事我一点都不记得了。我已经把它从记忆里彻底抹掉了。

lines.en: : Well you did. And I think you might have been right.
lines.zh: : 可你确实说过。而且我觉得你那时候可能是对的。

lines.en: : Love isn’t something you can go out searching for. It’s something that comes to you naturally.
lines.zh: : 爱不是你出门去找就能找到的东西。它是自然而然来到你身边的。

lines.en: During times like these, it’s best to regurgitate the words of people wiser than you.
lines.zh: 这种时候，最好的办法就是把比你聪明的人说过的话复述一遍。

lines.en: I don’t even marginally believe what I just said to Rin, but I think it will make her happy.
lines.zh: 我刚才对 Rin 说的那些，我自己连一丁点都不信，但我觉得那会让她开心。

lines.en: If I were to speak from the heart, I’d tell her that true love doesn’t exist and to just go out and find someone she’s sexually attracted to.
lines.zh: 如果要说真心话，我会告诉她真爱根本不存在，让她干脆去找个让她有性冲动的人算了。

lines.en: I’d tell her to give up on feeling anything ever again.
lines.zh: 我会叫她放弃再去感受任何东西。

lines.en: Life is better when you love nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都不爱的时候，人生反而更好过。

lines.en: Sure, it’s still life at the end of the day, so it’s not something amazing.
lines.zh: 当然，说到底那依然是人生，所以也算不上什么了不起的事。

lines.en: But at least you’ll be able to end a confession to someone without spending the night crying afterwards.
lines.zh: 但至少你在跟人表白之后，不用再花一整晚哭。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba11
: So...are you saying I should just...try my luck with someone else?
lines.zh: : 所以……你是说我该……干脆去别人身上碰碰运气？

lines.en: : Are you really that far away from being attached to someone that this sounds like an easy feat to you?
lines.zh: : 你真的已经对谁都没那么依恋了吗，依恋到觉得这事听起来轻而易举？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba12
: It’s been years, dude...
lines.zh: : 都过去好几年了，老兄……

lines.en: : I can’t just change my outlook on things at the drop of a hat.
lines.zh: : 我没法说改就改，一瞬间就把对事情的看法换掉。

lines.en: : You don’t have to. I just don’t want you to think that this one thing is going to be the end of your life.
lines.zh: : 你不需要换。我只是不希望你觉得这一件事就会是你人生的终点。

lines.en: : There’s still plenty you have going for you.
lines.zh: : 你身上还有很多值得期待的东西。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba13
: That’s right. You still have us.
lines.zh: : 没错。你还有我们。

lines.en: : Molly, too.
lines.zh: : 还有 Molly。

lines.en: : She’s been really worried about you, you know?
lines.zh: : 她真的很担心你，你知道吗？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba14
: That doesn’t surprise me...she worries about everything.
lines.zh: : 我倒不意外……她什么都担心。

lines.en: : To be fair, I think her worrying is kind of warranted this time.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我觉得她这次的担心是情有可原的。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’ll happen when you just disappear in the middle of a vacation.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你在度假中途突然消失，那当然会这样。

lines.en: : You two better be careful. Since both of you left before the end, people might start to think you guys don’t like them or something.
lines.zh: : 你们两个最好小心点。既然你们都在结束之前就走了，别人说不定会觉得你们不喜欢他们什么的。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba15
: Wait, really?! That’s not why I left at all! I just wasn’t feeling well and-
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？！我走根本不是因为那个！我只是身体不舒服，而且——

lines.en: : Excuse me, Futaba. But this is my time. Hearing about your stomach ache won’t help mend my broken heart.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，Futaba。但现在是我的时间是。听你讲肚子痛，可治不好我的破碎之心。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba16
: Oh...right. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。抱歉。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. I’m only kidding.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Just letting me lay on you is enough to make me feel a little better.
lines.zh: : 光是让我躺在你身上，就足以让我好受一点了。

lines.en: : I know you two care about me and...somehow or another, I’ll get through this.
lines.zh: : 我知道你们两个在乎我，而且……不管怎么样，我会挺过去的。

lines.en: : It’s not the end of the world, it just feels like it.
lines.zh: : 这不是世界末日，只是感觉像而已。

lines.en: That’s a good way of putting it.
lines.zh: 这个说法不错。

lines.en: I’ve seen the end of the world.
lines.zh: 我见过世界末日。

lines.en: I think.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: And, in a roundabout way, I can imagine that Rin {i}is{/i} feeling something similar to how I felt back then.
lines.zh: 而拐了个弯想想，我能想象 Rin 现在的感受，和我当时{i}有{/i}点类似。

lines.en: Confused. Alone. Hopeless.
lines.zh: 困惑。孤独。绝望。

lines.en: An endless combination of unfortunate adjectives, all with their own negative connotations.
lines.zh: 无穷无尽的不幸形容词，每一个都带着自己的负面意味。

lines.en: We find ways to weave them together into beautiful tapestries and drape them over our destinations, so when we walk out onto a roof to meet our end, it feels a little like home.
lines.zh: 我们想办法把它们编织成美丽的挂毯，披在我们的目的地上，于是当我们走上天台去迎接自己的终结时，那感觉就有点像家。

lines.en: But home is nowhere.
lines.zh: 可家在虚无之处。

lines.en: And we are here.
lines.zh: 而我们在这里。

lines.en: So I guess all that’s left to do is build a new one.
lines.zh: 所以我想，剩下的就只有再造一个了。

lines.en: : So, what now?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来怎么办？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba17
: Hm? Well, I was planning on being a wimp for a few more days and crying until my tear ducts give up on me.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我打算再当几天窝囊废，一直哭到泪腺罢工为止。

lines.en: : And I was planning on doing laundry every night so I wouldn’t run out of pajamas from drying all of her tears.
lines.zh: : 而我打算每晚都洗衣服，免得她把眼泪都哭干之后，我没睡衣可换。

lines.en: : You two really are like sisters, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你们两个真的跟姐妹一样，不是吗？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba18
: We are.
lines.zh: : 我们是。

lines.en: : And I also double as a pillow. And a support dog.
lines.zh: : 我还兼任枕头。还有抚慰犬。

lines.en: : I can be pretty multi-talented in times of desperation.
lines.zh: : 走投无路的时候，我还挺多才多艺的。

lines.en: : She’s the best pillow. I’m happy that I’m coherent enough this time to take advantage of that.
lines.zh: : 她是最好的枕头。我很高兴这次我清醒到能好好利用这一点。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba19
: Me too. Your sadness is a lot easier to handle when I know what’s causing it.
lines.zh: : 我也是。知道你难过的原因之后，你的悲伤要好处理多了。

lines.en: : Trust me, I know.
lines.zh: : 相信我，我懂。

lines.en: : There was one weird thing that happened the night of the rejection, though.
lines.zh: : 不过被拒绝那晚，发生了一件很怪的事。

lines.en: : Weird? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 怪？什么意思？

lines.en: : It was almost like a delusion.
lines.zh: : 简直就像幻觉一样。

lines.en: : When I was laying next to Sensei and he was rubbing my head, I started hearing things.
lines.zh: : 我躺在 Sensei 旁边、他揉着我的头的时候，我开始听到一些声音。

lines.en: : It might sound crazy, but it was kind of like hearing time itself passing us by.
lines.zh: : 听起来可能很疯，但有点像听到时间本身从我们身边流过。

lines.en: : It got me thinking, “Oh no. It’s happening again. I’m spiralling out of control.”
lines.zh: : 那让我想，「哦不。又来了。我又要失控了。」

lines.en: : But, before I knew it, it was all gone.
lines.zh: : 可我还没反应过来，它就全消失了。

lines.en: : The sound of time turned into a deafening silence. And no matter how much I screamed, there just wasn’t anything there.
lines.zh: : 时间的声音变成了震耳欲聋的寂静。而不管我怎么尖叫，那里就是什么都没有。

lines.en: : Has anything like that ever happened to you?
lines.zh: : 你们有过类似的事吗？

lines.en: : Not that I can remember...And that sounds like something that would definitely leave a lasting impression on me.
lines.zh: : 我记得是没有……而且那听起来像是肯定会给我留下深刻印象的事。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba20
: How about you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Have you ever experienced anything like what Rin is talking about?
lines.zh: : 你经历过 Rin 说的那种事吗？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba21
scene rinfutaba20
: {s}Far too often.{/s} No. I’ve never experienced anything like that.
lines.zh: : {s}太经常了。{/s}不。我从来没经历过那种事。

lines.en: : It was probably just some weird...depression-related thing. Who even knows?
lines.zh: : 大概只是什么奇怪的……跟抑郁有关的东西吧。谁知道呢？

lines.en: : No use dwelling on it now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过现在纠结这个也没用了。

lines.en: : I’ve just gotta keep moving forward. And when my feet get too heavy to lift, I always have you two to pick me up and carry me wherever I need to go next.
lines.zh: : 我只需要继续往前走。而当我的脚沉重到抬不起来的时候，我永远有你们两个可以把我扶起来、背我去任何我接下来该去的地方。

lines.en: : That’s true. But don’t expect me to give you a piggyback ride to the cafe any time soon. That’s like three miles from here.
lines.zh: : 这倒是真的。不过别指望我近期会背你去咖啡厅。那儿离这儿大概三英里呢。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba22
: And you call yourself my friend...
lines.zh: : 你还说自己是我的朋友……

lines.en: : I guess Futaba will just have to carry me.
lines.zh: : 那我猜只能让 Futaba 背我了。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba23
: I’d be lucky if I could even make it down the block giving you a piggyback ride...
lines.zh: : 我要是能背着你走过一个街区就算走运了……

lines.en: : You deny me {i}and{/i} call me fat? What is this treachery?
lines.zh: : 你一边拒绝我、{i}一边{/i}说我胖？这是什么背叛行为？

lines.en: : Okay, well...I guess I’ll leave you two to it.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那……我看我还是让你们两个继续吧。

lines.en: scene rinfutaba24
: Huh? You’re leaving already?
lines.zh: : 哈？你这就走了？

lines.en: : I am. I just wanted to help cheer you up, but I’m pretty sure Futaba is a lot more help than I am in that regard.
lines.zh: : 是的。我本来只是想来帮你振作一点，但我敢肯定在这方面 Futaba 比我管用得多。

lines.en: : But I’ll stop by the cafe again soon and we can talk.
lines.zh: : 不过我很快会再来咖啡厅，到时候我们聊聊。

lines.en: : You really don’t have to leave. I want you here.
lines.zh: : 你真的不必走。我想让你在这儿。

lines.en: : I’m okay with you staying, too.
lines.zh: : 我也没意见你留下。

lines.en: One of the most important parts of life is figuring out when you are and aren’t needed.
lines.zh: 人生最重要的事情之一，就是弄清楚什么时候需要你、什么时候不需要你。

lines.en: If I remain here any longer, I’ll just wind up bringing things down in one way or another.
lines.zh: 我要是再待下去，迟早会以某种方式把气氛拖下去。

lines.en: Besides, after hearing Rin’s tangent about time, I’m suddenly feeling a little bit off myself.
lines.zh: 再说，听完 Rin 关于时间那一通之后，我自己也突然有点不对劲了。

lines.en: I’m not exactly sure why, but I feel like I need to go.
lines.zh: 我不太确定为什么，但我感觉自己该走了。

lines.en: I should let these sisters just...be sisters for the night.
lines.zh: 我该让这对姐妹……今晚就只做姐妹。

lines.en: : Thanks, but I really should be going.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不过我真的该走了。

lines.en: : Maybe we can all do something together soon, though?
lines.zh: : 不过也许我们三个很快能一起做点什么？

lines.en: scene rinfutaba25
: Is this you volunteering to take us to an all-you-can-eat dessert buffet?
lines.zh: : 这是你在自告奋勇带我们去吃甜点自助吗？

lines.en: : That’s the one thing guaranteed to mend any [young]maiden’s heart.
lines.zh: : 那是唯一保证能治好任何[young]少女之心的东西。

lines.en: : Then why wasn’t that the first place you went after the beach?
lines.zh: : 那你从海滩回来之后为什么没先去那儿？

lines.en: : Because I don’t have enough money, duhh.
lines.zh: : 因为我钱不够啊，笨。

lines.en: : We’ll...figure something out.
lines.zh: : 我们……会想办法的。

lines.en: : I can’t guarantee it will be {i}that{/i}, but we can definitely go out on a “Fix Rin’s Heart” trip soon.
lines.zh: : 我不能保证就是{i}那个{/i}，但我们绝对可以很快来一趟「修复 Rin 之心」之旅。

lines.en: : I’ll free up my calendar...
lines.zh: : 我会把日程空出来……

lines.en: scene black
I say goodbye to the two of them and make my way back to the streets of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我跟她们两个道了别，踏上返回 Kumon-mi 街道的路。

lines.en: It’s another night teetering on the brink of being cold.
lines.zh: 又是一个在寒冷边缘摇摇欲坠的夜晚。

lines.en: Summer is on life-support.
lines.zh: 夏天已经靠生命维持系统吊着了。

lines.en: And I walk home thinking about clocks and how they correlate to the underlying sadness in everything.
lines.zh: 而我走在回家的路上，想着时钟，以及它们与万事万物底下那份悲伤的关联。
